articles.summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Nov. 12, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pulmonx Corporation (Nasdaq: LUNG) (“Pulmonx” or the "Company"), a global leader in minimally invasive treatments for lung disease, today reported financial results for the third quarter of 2025 ended September 30, 2025.
articles.title: Pulmonx Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
